verdict.rationale: Foreloop provides a review step for automated work: nothing runs until a person approves a task contract, and agent output arrives as GitHub pull requests that get automatic product-review checks. Skills are installed into the repository checkout, which only implies git-based versioning. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of automation definitions (loops, skills, task contracts), any documented rollback or revert mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
